title: Add a real market-price feed
what_changes: Every market column becomes populated and gate V-08 becomes testable, turning this from a model pack into a betting record
evidence: All market columns are blank because nfl.com publishes no odds (flag F-01)
option_a: Buy a historical odds feed and re-run the backtest against real closing lines
option_b: Have the user upload archived lines for the 137 completed games
option_c: Keep prices out of scope and publish a model-only product, with ROI explicitly marked unmeasurable

title: Extend the ledger across multiple seasons
what_changes: The sample-size gate stops being marginal and every confidence interval shrinks sharply
evidence: 88 graded bets still give a Wilson interval that spans the break-even rate for most signals
option_a: Extend backwards through prior official seasons and re-run all gates
option_b: Keep the sample at 2026 only and publish every result with an explicit small-sample warning
option_c: Extend to the current season plus one prior season as a compromise

title: Publish lines against a flat -110 assumption, or not at all
what_changes: Decides whether the Own Lines page shows a hypothetical price or shows model numbers only
evidence: -110 is a modelling convenience, not an observed price; publishing it unqualified would overstate what was actually verified
option_a: Show model numbers only, with market columns permanently blank
option_b: Show model numbers plus a clearly labelled hypothetical -110 scenario
option_c: Show model numbers plus a scenario band across -105, -110 and -115

title: Replace the ridge rating model with a joint model
what_changes: Side and total would be fitted together instead of in two separate passes
evidence: The two models currently produce totals whose bias is measured but not corrected (flag F-08)
option_a: Keep the two simple ridge models - they are auditable and deterministic
option_b: Add a third model and compare it on the same walk-forward harness
option_c: Add situational features - rest, divisional, travel - and re-test on the same harness

title: Add a player-prop module
what_changes: Unlocks the prop-bet and prop-parlay part of the brief, which is currently blocked
evidence: No official player-statistic source was in scope, so correlation C-10 is uncomputed (flag F-06)
option_a: Fetch official nfl.com player statistics and build a props table with its own gates
option_b: Leave props out and say so plainly on the site
option_c: Build a props page that lists the data required but publishes no numbers

title: Weekly automated re-run
what_changes: The pack stops going stale between sessions
evidence: The whole pipeline is deterministic and cheap, but nothing runs it on a clock
option_a: Enable a scheduled workflow that rebuilds, verifies and publishes every week
option_c: Enable a weekly rebuild that opens a pull request rather than merging automatically

title: Find an alternate official source for Houston's depth chart
what_changes: Backup and deficiency tracking covers the whole league instead of 31 clubs
evidence: HOU publishes its depth chart only as a raster image, so it has no transcribed chart (flag F-09)
option_a: Fetch each club's official depth chart and re-run
option_b: Leave those clubs blank and flagged
option_c: Substitute the official injury-report practice columns as a partial proxy and label it clearly as a proxy

title: Make the Flagged for Review page a first-class deliverable
what_changes: Irregularities stop being buried in an appendix and become reviewable in one place
evidence: Every flag raised across data, personnel, statistics and scope, in one place
option_a: Ship the flagged page prominently in the main navigation
option_b: Keep flags inside each table only
option_c: Ship the flagged page and require a reviewer acknowledgement before any flag is cleared

title: Add a decision log recording the option chosen for each suggestion
what_changes: The reviewer's choices become auditable rather than verbal
evidence: Every suggestion is currently marked AWAITING DECISION with no record of a choice
option_a: Add a decisions table recording suggestion, chosen option, date and rationale

title: Make beating a naive baseline a hard gate
what_changes: Stops a model that merely restates 'better teams win' from being presented as an edge
evidence: Gate V-07 was added after seeing how close the model and the point-differential baseline are
option_a: Make V-07 a blocking gate for any strategy promoted to the leaderboard
option_c: Make V-07 blocking only for strategies with fewer than 200 graded bets
